quests.instruction: What is the action word for cutting food into small pieces with a knife?
quests.hint: Think about what a grown-up does to vegetables before cooking, using a big knife.
quests.explanation: Chop means to cut something into pieces using quick, choppy movements. Grown-ups chop vegetables for soup!
quests.funFact: Chopping food into smaller pieces helps it cook faster and more evenly!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for cutting something into thin, flat pieces?
quests.hint: Think about how bread looks after it comes out of a loaf, cut into thin pieces.
quests.explanation: Slice means to cut something into thin, flat pieces. We slice bread and fruit for lunch!
quests.funFact: A whole loaf of bread is cut into many slices before we eat it!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for rubbing food against a tool with tiny holes to make small bits?
quests.hint: Think about turning a block of cheese into tiny, soft shreds.
quests.explanation: Grate means to rub food across a tool with small holes to make tiny pieces. We grate cheese for pizza!
quests.funFact: Grating cheese into small pieces helps it melt quickly and evenly!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for mixing something quickly with a special looped tool?
quests.hint: Think about mixing eggs very fast until they turn frothy.
quests.explanation: Whisk means to mix something quickly with a looped tool. We whisk eggs to make them fluffy!
quests.funFact: Whisking adds tiny bubbles of air that make batter light and fluffy!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for heating water until it bubbles and gets very hot?
quests.hint: Think about what happens to a pot of water left on a hot stove.
quests.explanation: Boil means to heat a liquid until it bubbles. We boil water to cook pasta!
quests.funFact: Water boils and turns into steam when it gets hot enough!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for cooking food in a hot pan with a little oil?
quests.hint: Think about how an egg sizzles when it is cooking in a pan.
quests.explanation: Fry means to cook food in a hot pan with oil. We fry eggs for breakfast!
quests.funFact: A frying pan gets very hot, so only a grown-up should use it!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for cooking food slowly inside a hot oven?
quests.hint: Think about how cookies smell wonderful while they cook inside a warm oven.
quests.explanation: Bake means to cook food slowly inside an oven. We bake cookies and bread!
quests.funFact: Baking uses gentle, all-around heat to cook food evenly!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for cooking food with dry heat until it turns golden brown?
quests.hint: Think about vegetables cooking slowly on a tray in the oven.
quests.explanation: Roast means to cook food with dry heat until golden brown. We roast vegetables in the oven!
quests.funFact: Roasting brings out rich, warm flavors in food!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for mixing things together until they become smooth?
quests.hint: Think about turning fruit and yogurt into a smooth drink.
quests.explanation: Blend means to mix things together until smooth. We blend fruit to make a tasty smoothie!
quests.funFact: A blender spins very fast to turn chunky food into a smooth drink!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for pressing and folding dough with your hands?
quests.hint: Think about pushing and folding soft, stretchy bread dough on a table.
quests.explanation: Knead means to press and fold dough with your hands. We knead dough to make bread!
quests.funFact: Kneading dough helps bread turn out soft and fluffy after baking!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for adding pretty things to make something look special?
quests.hint: Think about adding sprinkles and icing to a plain cupcake.
quests.explanation: Decorate means to add pretty things to make something look special. We decorate cakes and rooms for parties!
quests.funFact: People decorate their homes for holidays with lights and colorful objects!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for doing something fun to mark a happy, special day?
quests.hint: Think about what your family does on your birthday.
quests.explanation: Celebrate means to do something fun for a special day. We celebrate birthdays with cake and songs!
quests.funFact: Families around the world celebrate special days in many different happy ways!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for covering something in paper, often as a gift?
quests.hint: Think about covering a present in colorful paper before a birthday party.
quests.explanation: Wrap means to cover something in paper. We wrap presents for birthdays!
quests.funFact: People have wrapped gifts in colorful paper for hundreds of years!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for taking the paper off a gift to see what is inside?
quests.hint: Think about what you do to a present the moment you get it.
quests.explanation: Unwrap means to take the paper off something. We unwrap presents on our birthday!
quests.funFact: The exciting feeling before you unwrap a gift is called anticipation!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for asking someone to come to an event?
quests.hint: Think about what you do to ask a friend to your birthday party.
quests.explanation: Invite means to ask someone to come to an event. We invite friends to our party!
quests.funFact: A special card that invites someone to a party is called an invitation!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for saying a friendly hello to someone?
quests.hint: Think about the first thing you say when a friend arrives.
quests.explanation: Greet means to say a friendly hello. We greet our friends with a smile!
quests.funFact: People greet each other in different ways in different countries, like waving or bowing!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for telling someone you are grateful for something?
quests.hint: Think about what you say after someone gives you a gift.
quests.explanation: Thank means to tell someone you are grateful. We thank people who help us!
quests.funFact: Saying thank you is a simple way to make someone feel appreciated!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for telling people each other's names for the first time?
quests.hint: Think about what you say when a new friend meets your family.
quests.explanation: Introduce means to tell people each other's names. We introduce new friends to our family!
quests.funFact: When you introduce two people, you help them become friends!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for warmly greeting someone who has just arrived?
quests.hint: Think about what you say and do when a guest first walks through your door.
quests.explanation: Welcome means to warmly greet someone who arrives. We welcome guests into our home!
quests.funFact: Some families have a special mat by the door that says welcome!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for saying sorry when you make a mistake?
quests.hint: Think about what you say after you accidentally bump into someone.
quests.explanation: Apologize means to say sorry for a mistake. We apologize when we accidentally hurt someone's feelings!
quests.funFact: A kind apology can help two friends feel better and stay close!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for telling someone you will really do something?
quests.hint: Think about what you say when you tell a friend you will definitely help them tomorrow.
quests.explanation: Promise means to tell someone you will really do something. We promise to keep our word!
quests.funFact: Keeping a promise is one of the best ways to show you are trustworthy!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for telling someone about danger before it happens?
quests.hint: Think about what you shout to a friend before they step in a puddle.
quests.explanation: Warn means to tell someone about danger ahead of time. We warn our friends about slippery floors!
quests.funFact: Warning signs use bright colors like red and yellow so people notice them quickly!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for being kind to someone who feels sad or hurt?
quests.hint: Think about what you do for a friend who is crying.
quests.explanation: Comfort means to be kind to someone who feels sad. We comfort a friend with a hug!
quests.funFact: A soft voice and a warm hug can comfort someone who is feeling upset!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for cheering someone on so they feel brave enough to try?
quests.hint: Think about what you say to a friend who is scared to try something new.
quests.explanation: Encourage means to cheer someone on so they feel brave. We encourage our friends to try their best!
quests.funFact: Kind, encouraging words can help someone believe in themselves!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for telling someone they did a wonderful job?
quests.hint: Think about what your teacher says when you finish your work well.
quests.explanation: Praise means to tell someone they did great. We praise our friends for trying their best!
quests.funFact: Hearing kind praise can make anyone feel proud and happy!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for saying something nice about someone?
quests.hint: Think about what you might say about a friend's cool new shoes.
quests.explanation: Compliment means to say something nice about someone. We compliment a friend's artwork!
quests.funFact: Giving a kind compliment can brighten someone's whole day!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for telling someone well done after their success?
quests.hint: Think about what you say to a friend who just won a race.
quests.explanation: Congratulate means to tell someone well done. We congratulate a friend who wins a game!
quests.funFact: People often congratulate each other with a smile, a hug, or a high five!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for making something clear so someone can understand it?
quests.hint: Think about what a teacher does to help you understand a tricky math problem.
quests.explanation: Explain means to make something clear for someone. We explain the rules of a new game!
quests.funFact: Explaining something well means using simple words that are easy to follow!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for using words to tell what someone or something is like?
quests.hint: Think about telling a friend what your new puppy looks like.
quests.explanation: Describe means to use words to tell what something is like. We describe our favorite animal!
quests.funFact: When you describe something well, others can picture it in their mind!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for talking with others to share ideas about something?
quests.hint: Think about talking with your class about your favorite book.
quests.explanation: Discuss means to talk with others to share ideas. We discuss our favorite stories in class!
quests.funFact: Discussing ideas with friends can help you think of things you never noticed before!
